name: Footwork & Finishing
summary: Warm up your handle, then sharpen pivots, jump stops and finishes before a conditioning shooting test.

drills.name: Rhythm Dribble Ladder
drills.summary: Wake up your hands with a steady beat that builds from low to quick.
steps: Start in an athletic stance with the ball on your right side.
Do 10 low, hard dribbles, then 10 at knee height, then 10 at hip height.
Switch to your left hand and repeat the ladder.
Finish with 10 crossovers, 10 between the legs and 10 behind the back.
Keep going through the ladder until the timer ends.

drills.name: Jump-Stop Pivot Series
drills.summary: Stop on balance in the paint and use pivots to create a clean finish.
steps: Set a cone at the free throw line. Start at half court.
Drive to the cone and land a two-foot jump stop just inside it.
Front pivot toward the rim and finish with a layup.
Next rep, reverse pivot away from the imaginary help, then finish.
Alternate drives from the left and right side each rep.

drills.name: Elbow Turn & Shoot
drills.summary: Catch with your back to the rim, square up fast and knock down elbow jumpers.
steps: Stand at the right elbow facing half court.
Spin the ball out to yourself and catch it on a hop.
Pivot on your inside foot to face the rim and shoot.
Get your rebound and do 5 shots, then switch to the left elbow.
Alternate front and reverse pivots each round.

drills.name: Half-Court Sprint Shots
drills.summary: Shoot tired after a sprint dribble, just like late in a game.
steps: Start at the right elbow with the ball.
Speed dribble to half court, touch the line with your foot and dribble back.
Jump stop at the elbow and shoot.
Rebound, dribble to the left elbow and repeat the sprint.
Count your makes and try to beat the score next time.
